name: Pizarral (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, white and yellow, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Pizarral (a slate square and a star on white, and a bull on yellow).
history: The flag is a rectangular cloth of proportions 3:2 (length by width), tierced vertically, with the stripes blue at the hoist, yellow at the fly and white in the centre bearing the municipal arms, of a height of 2/5 of the width of the flag.

features.role: Pizarral arms — slate square and star on white, bull on yellow
